comment: Registry of AMD-maintained and community llama.cpp forks for nightly perf regression tracking. Add new forks by appending entries — no code changes needed. binary_url uses {version} as a placeholder substituted at runtime from the latest GitHub release tag.

forks.label: llama.cpp ROCm Nightly (lemonade-sdk)
forks.notes: Lemonade nightly ROCm channel. Built via TheRock SDK. Not upstreamed.

forks.label: llama.cpp ROCm Stable (lemonade-sdk)
forks.notes: Lemonade stable ROCm channel. Not upstreamed.

forks.label: llama.cpp gfx11 (AMD-Ecosystem)
forks.notes: Nightly dated builds. Tag format: gfx11-rocm-nightly-YYYYMMDD. Single multiarch binary — covers all RDNA3/3.5 targets. Linux only, no Windows binary. Runs on Linux ROCm self-hosted runner.

forks.label: llama.cpp Vulkan (upstream reference)
forks.notes: Upstream ggml-org baseline. Used as performance reference for fork comparisons.

forks.label: llama.cpp HRX (ROCm/ggml-staging-automation)
forks.notes: Experimental HRX backend. Linux gfx1151 only. Auto-discovers all 'llamacpp-hrx' models from server_models.json; add an optional model_filter to pin a subset.

forks.label: llama.cpp Strix Halo (halo-box)
forks.notes: Community llama.cpp fork perf-tuned for AMD Strix Halo (gfx1151). Ships standard llama-server binaries in the lemonade-sdk/llamacpp-rocm release layout (per-arch ROCm zips + one Vulkan zip, Linux only), so it drops into the llamacpp recipe as a ROCm binary swap — routed via `lemonade config set llamacpp.rocm_bin=<file> rocm_channel=nightly` and benched with --backend rocm. NO C++ change, same mechanism as llamacpp-amd-ecosystem-gfx11. Tracks the gfx1151 ROCm build only; the Vulkan build would duplicate llamacpp-upstream-vulkan. Tag scheme: sequential bNNNN from b1000. NOTE: intentionally NOT marked experimental — that would flip the driver to require_hot=False and pull ALL llamacpp models; leaving it off pins the run to the same hot model set the rocm forks bench (apples-to-apples, self-maintaining). Kept enabled:false until a manual `fork_filter=halo-box-strix` run confirms the gfx1151 zip downloads, the binary launches (smoke test passes), and hot models produce valid TPS; then flip enabled:true.
